items.title: 10th SOSG National Games 2025
items.description: Successfully staged from 31 May to 2 June 2025 after an 8-year hiatus, celebrating sportsmanship with 550+ athletes and 1,500+ volunteers.

items.title: Play Inclusive 2026
items.description: Reached over 2,200 participants across various different sports at the Singapore Expo, reinforcing unity through sports partnership.

items.title: SOEA Regional Bowling Competition 2026
items.description: The Singapore delegation comprised nine members: six athletes, two coaches and the Head of Delegation. Team Singapore recorded five gold medals, two silver medals and two bronze-medals results.
